[ASSISTANT_SAID] The best time to visit Europe is spring (April to May) and autumn (September to October) for fewer tourists and mild weather.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Must-see destinations in Europe include Paris, Rome, Barcelona, Amsterdam, and London.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Hidden gems in Europe include Croatia, Portugal, Slovenia, Ireland, and the Czech Republic.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for traveling include researching destinations, considering transportation options, budgeting, learning basic phrases in local languages, and being flexible with itineraries.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The driving distance from Dubrovnik to Plitvice Lakes National Park is approximately 570 km (354 miles) and takes around 6-7 hours by car.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Bus travel from Dubrovnik to Plitvice can take around 8-10 hours.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended stops along the way from Dubrovnik to Plitvice include Split, Trogir, Sibenik, Krka National Park, and Slunj.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] In Split, must-see attractions include Diocletian's Palace, the Cathedral of Saint Domnius, the Riva Waterfront, Mestrovic Gallery, Marjan Hill, and Bačvice Beach.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended experiences in Split include taking a food tour, exploring the Green Market, watching a football match, and taking a sunset cruise.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended restaurants in Split include Villa Spiza and Konoba Dioklecijan.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Must-try dishes in Croatian cuisine include peka, seafood risotto, and local specialties.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Spring (April to May) offers mild weather and fewer tourists, while autumn (September to October) has warm weather and many festivals.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] In spring, some tourist infrastructure might not be fully operational, while in autumn, some might start to close down for winter.
